changed_assumption.prior: Whole-stage stale/delta hidden substitution. Prior pilot used Thinking-1.4B, not the current dense Base targets.
changed_assumption.screened: Recompute current attention, QKV, RoPE, current-token KV, and residual. Consume only the same-token same-layer prior-pass normalized FFN contribution.
changed_assumption.remaining_approximation: Current causal inputs differ from exact baseline inputs after the first stale FFN contribution.

cache_contract.one_pass_lag: Pass r consumes exactly producer pass r-1 for the same token and physical layer.
cache_contract.miss: Wait. Selecting an older ready entry changes the contract to variable lag.
cache_contract.input_lifetime: Retain immutable u until remote reads complete.
cache_contract.output_lifetime: Do not overwrite a cached contribution before all consumers finish.

critical_path.abstraction: One FIFO remote FFN owner. Service times are symbolic, not calibrated.
critical_path.F: F[r,l] = max(U[r,l] + s[r,l], Fprev) + f[r,l] + v[r,l]

costs.a: Current attention, current KV operations, and norms through u
costs.i: Cached branch access and residual integration

critical_path.constant_cost_front_floor: L(a+s+f+v+i)+n + 3[L(a+i)+n], before head/commit and only if all replacement deadlines succeed
critical_path.lagged_R4_commit: R4 consumes R3 contributions. R4 refresh results do not affect this output.
critical_path.mandatory_drain: max(front_done, max_l F[4,l]) if final refresh jobs must finish before buffer reuse
critical_path.current_FFN_R4: Use F[4,l] at every R4 layer. Restore the R4 FFN dependency chain but retain earlier approximate state/history.
critical_path.repair_limit: Late FFN results on approximate inputs cannot repair consumed downstream QKV/KV, norms, gates, or hidden states without a valid repair procedure.

FFN_evaluations.interpretation: Skipping final refreshes is generic approximate cache reuse, not exact asynchronous replacement.

structural_payload_not_measured_traffic.HBM_reads: Not measured. Logical matrix use does not establish physical HBM traffic.
